study_type: New exploratory retrospective study after observing the old 20261021 pilot; not an amendment or rescue of its negative primary result.

known_information.source_caveat: PMC4938795 mutates TCR CDR/FR in A6-c134 and RD1-MART1HIGH, not antigen peptide. PMC5114409 reuses RD1 scanning and selected variants, not a third independent DMS family.

base_model.name: historical strict_full fold0 joint model seed7 epoch40
base_model.fixed_backbone_scope: Sequence identity and existing N/CA/C/O geometry only. Candidate substitutions at fixed backbone do not generate new backbone conformations.
base_model.overlap_policy: Audit exact, direct threshold-chain, and available transitive-family membership for every new actual template and candidate. No-ITrace alone is insufficient. Functional-label independence and protein-family independence are separate; disclose in-domain panels rather than calling them unseen proteins.

data_contract.independent_unit: biological receptor-antigen-assay family, not publication, donor replicate, template, candidate conformer or random seed
data_contract.candidate_unit: unique full candidate sequence in one fixed receptor/pMHC/assay context
data_contract.task_object: TCR_mutation or antigen_peptide_mutation; never relabel one as the other
data_contract.endpoint_separation: Yeast enrichment, expression/display, pMHC stability, T-cell activity and SPR KD are separate outcomes. DMS yeast enrichment is an assay proxy affected by display and is not KD or cell activity.
data_contract.labels: Aggregate measured replicates using source-prescribed processing; retain raw counts, coverage, replicate variance, WT normalization and construct identities. No candidate exclusion based on model score.
data_contract.censoring: No-boundary-to-exact substitution. Only uncensored quantitative primary outcomes can enter regression; source-defined categorical hits may enter hit summaries without invented continuous values.
data_contract.hit_rule: Use an original-source functional threshold when explicitly reported and fixed. Otherwise enrichment log2(candidate/WT)>=1 is an operational two-fold enrichment-proxy endpoint only if WT normalization is validated. If neither applies, report recovery of the label-top-decile as a relative finite-panel retrieval metric; do not call it above-parent improvement or validated functional hits.
data_contract.threshold_uses_hidden_labels: The evaluator may compute a prespecified full-pool top-decile cutoff only for offline scoring. No selection policy receives cutoff, unseen label values, hit counts or test metrics.
data_contract.unusable_sources: A table containing only eight selected beneficial mutations cannot supply a complete pool, negatives, enrichment hit rate or active-learning evaluation. Record not_evaluable, do not fabricate a missing saturation matrix.
data_contract.development_holdout: Old1G4/A6 are development only. Shared RD1 data across the two DMS papers remain one family; related engineered receptors are disclosed. New antigen panels must be distinct biological families to support independent antigen claims.
data_contract.new_antigen_source: Seven distinct TCR saturation-peptide EC50 panels from pinned HERMES mutation_effects/mskcc and original avidity_curves.xlsx/infer_ec50s source. Verify receptor relationships, assay construct and all candidate coverage before treating as independent families.
data_contract.EC50: Source fitted EC50 values archived only. Primary observed functional response source-bound by functional_endpoint_amendment.
data_contract.eligibility_before_evaluation: Curator supplies immutable per-panel candidate scope/endpoint/censoring/threshold contract and hash before evaluation. Label-derived distribution gates assess task suitability only; they do not select a better-performing model, threshold or subset.

mode1_site_nomination.question: Does parent-only predicted local mobility identify positions at which an equal-sized substitution experiment recovers more favorable measured effects?
mode1_site_nomination.scope: Antigen mutation-site prioritization:9 positions with19 nonparent substitutions each, two selected sites=38 assays. Recognition-retaining variant yield, not proven affinity enhancement.
mode1_site_nomination.eligibility: At least6 measured positions with all19 nonparent amino-acid substitutions passing source coverage/QC; if incomplete, use a single fixed shared substitution set across every eligible position, at least10 substitutions each. Do not let positions with more measured candidates have larger experimental budgets.
mode1_site_nomination.site_score: For the unchanged parent residue at each experimentally covered position: score_R=empirical percentile of predicted RMSF among actual2431 training labels of the same amino-acid type; score_H=the analogous percentile of joint Hchi where chi exists. score_joint=(score_R+score_H)/2 for nonGly/nonAla; for Gly/Ala score_joint=score_R. Higher score nominates more dynamically permissive parent positions as an explicit unvalidated hypothesis; no claim that low mobility improves binding.
mode1_site_nomination.training_prior: Use only actual strict2431 training label values/chemical masks, one residue one value; no new DMS labels. Hash the per-AA reference ECDF. If unavailable, use an explicitly labelled parent-within-tested-position rank sensitivity, never silently substitute it as primary.
mode1_site_nomination.static_contact_degree: Number of unique partner residues with any parent heavy atom<=4.5A to the position; higher first.
mode1_site_nomination.static_relative_SASA: Parent per-residue sidechain SASA divided by a fixed training/source maximum; higher first. No DMS-trained static coefficients.
mode1_site_nomination.tie_break: lexical canonical residue key, shared across strategies; random strategy uses the20 paired fixed seeds
metrics: Number of recognition-retaining variants in equal38-assay budget
best and mean measured normalized response
fraction of all pool recognition-retaining variants recovered
mode1_site_nomination.success: Primary joint-high two-site recognition-retaining yield must exceed both static strategies and mean random in every context. A companion win cannot replace it. This tests antigen experimental prioritization, not above-parent affinity improvement.
mode1_site_nomination.companion_low: parent_joint_low=1-parent_joint_percentile. It is a predeclared competing hypothesis, never substituted for the primary on the basis of performance.
mode1_site_nomination.companion_partner_context: If feasible, remove the binding partner chains while keeping the parent target chain identities/backbone/residue order and using the same model. Site score is mean of abs(R_full-R_partner_removed)/training_R_sameAA_RMSscale and abs(H_full-H_partner_removed)/training_H_sameAA_RMSscale over defined metrics; G/A use R only. Higher indicates computational partner-context sensitivity, not real apo dynamics or a binding experiment.
mode1_site_nomination.parent_H_only_Gly_Ala: JointHchi undefined at Gly/Ala. In H-only ranking assign the predeclared neutral percentile0.5, flag undefined, and retain equal candidate/site scope; do not invent physical Hchi. Joint-high/low use defined R alone for these sites.
mode1_site_nomination.site_companions_role: Report every companion and both budgets separately; a companion win cannot establish primary joint-high success or be pooled with a different mode.

candidate_features.templates: One primary template per biological panel chosen before candidate outcomes/predictions; any sensitivity template is applied to every candidate and stays a separate technical analysis.
candidate_features.sequence: Same-length residue-aligned candidate sequence for each panel; no mutation-position onehot learned from heldout labels.
candidate_features.R_pattern: Full signed vector of candidate-minus-same-template-parent RMSF at the fixed U_R positions; no spatial mean, absolute-value reduction, best residue or post-result region selection.
candidate_features.H_pattern: Full signed vector of candidate-minus-same-template-parent joint Hchi at fixed U_H positions; chemical identity must remain unchanged at each paired site. Exclude all positions variable anywhere in the candidate library, plus Gly/Ala and undefined chi; no changed-amino-acid entropy comparisons.
candidate_features.U: Parent-completed-heavy-atom8A interface neighborhood around the variable molecular component, restricted to chemically unchanged spectator residues across the entire library. Freeze roles, author IDs, masks and distances before inference/label scoring. Antigen-library U uses unchanged HLA/TCR; receptor-library U may use unchanged pMHC and any unchanged spectator receptor residues.
candidate_features.normalization: Each R/H dimension is divided by the actual training same-AA metric reference RMS scale; fixed before new outcomes. No FlexPPI predicted variance used as epistemic uncertainty.
candidate_features.profile_missingness: A fixed position mask per panel and metric; no candidate-specific feature removal. Failed inputs stay in the accounting, and all strategies use exactly the same primary eligible candidate set.
candidate_features.static_source_contract: Select the original published fixed-backbone score column for each method from documented source code, not by correlation with EC50. Preserve raw score, score definition, orientation and parent subtraction; no AF3-relaxed/closest-template or target-outcome-selected column. Both external methods also get standalone zero-shot ranking comparisons using their published direction.
candidate_features.static_unavailable: If either predeclared published comparator is absent for candidates, record coverage failure; do not silently replace with a weaker method. Any restricted cohort is defined before new prediction/label evaluation and uses the same candidate IDs for all policies.

kernel_calibrator.numeric_block_kernel: RBF exp(-squared_distance/median_positive_pairwise_squared_distance); static dimensions use zero-preserving full-pool unlabeled RMS scaling, R/H use fixed training AA scales. Constant block yields allones kernel and is disclosed.
kernel_calibrator.label_free_pool_scaling: All candidate structures/features are available before experiments. Complete-pool unsupervised bandwidth/scaling is allowed and explicitly transductive; no hidden outcomes used.
kernel_calibrator.block_weights: equal mean over listed kernels; no performance-based weight tuning
kernel_calibrator.intercept: mean observed training-label value only; center training y, fit alpha=(Ktrain+n_train*0.1I)^-1(y-meantrain); predict meantrain+Ktest,train alpha
kernel_calibrator.signs: Learn phenotype association only from the shared initial observed examples; neither lower Hchi nor lower RMSF is prescribed as favorable.

mode2_common_pool_rerank.eligibility: Complete strong/weak quantitative pool N>=60; never positive-only selected candidates. Parent/reference excluded as a trivially repeated candidate.
mode2_common_pool_rerank.extra_budget: min(30,N-initial_n); report k5,10,20,30 where feasible; primary final fixed extra budget
mode2_common_pool_rerank.information: Identical initial candidate IDs and labels for every strategy in each seed; all remaining labels hidden until after one-shot selection.
mode2_common_pool_rerank.selection: Kernel models choose highest predicted phenotype; random chooses a fixed seeded permutation; sequence_diversity greedily maximizes minimum sequence-kernel distance to initial/chosen candidates, tie lexical ID.
metrics: new favorable hits in each extra-budget prefix
best measured outcome in extra selected candidates
best outcome including identical initial set
top-decile recovery of the hidden candidate pool
full hidden-pool Spearman and MAE only as secondary model diagnostics
mode2_common_pool_rerank.success: Joint-profile method must increase mean final-budget new favorable-hit yield over baseline and both random/sequence-diversity in each independent biological family. To claim both readouts help, it must additionally beat both one-readout ablations. Report paired seed differences and wins/ties/losses as seed variability, not20 independent biological replications.

mode3_feedback_selection.eligibility: Complete quantitative pool N>=100 with enough remaining candidates for20-to40 initial examples plus8 rounds of5. At least5 favorable and5 nonfavorable candidates required for a meaningful above-threshold retrieval assessment; otherwise continuous feasibility only, no favorable-discovery success claim.
mode3_feedback_selection.acquisition: Same policy for every kernel model: fit on currently observed labels; take4 unmeasured candidates by current predicted mean, then1 by maximum minimum kernel-induced distance to the already measured and the4 selected candidates. Reveal the five outcomes together after selection, then repeat. No outcome update within a batch. Random and pure sequence-diversity are explicit distinct reference policies.
mode3_feedback_selection.uncertainty: The exploration slot is feature-coverage novelty, not calibrated uncertainty; neither FlexPPI std nor an unvalidated kernel variance is called epistemic uncertainty.
metrics: cumulative favorable hits versus total assay count
cumulative best oriented measured outcome versus total count
first assay count at which the prespecified threshold is found; right-censored at budget if never found
area under cumulative-hit versus extra-budget curve, descriptive
mode3_feedback_selection.success: Same per-family final-budget yield criterion as mode2, with improved time-to-first-threshold as a separately reported efficiency outcome. Initial-set hits must be distinguished from newly acquired hits. No lucky seed, round or biological panel replaces the primary budget.

reporting.claims: A benefit means a concrete reduction of experimental search effort on the stated biological object and endpoint. Yeast-display gains do not prove TCR KD improvement or antigen optimization; T-cell peptide activity does not prove binding affinity or safety. New experimental validation would still be required for prospective design claims.

source_based_completion.reason: Seven HERMES/MSKCC complete peptide saturation panels include published HERMES-fixed and ProteinMPNN scores. These are stronger, feasible static comparators than rebuilding all1200 candidate sidechains for two geometric summaries.
source_based_completion.not_changed_from_old_pilot: The old20261021 study remains unchanged and negative. This contract defines a separately labelled exploratory study.

functional_endpoint_amendment.reason: Original three-dose curves available for all7 saturated peptide panels. Fitted CSV EC50 has log-base/coverage ambiguity; use complete observed highest-dose response for every candidate.
functional_endpoint_amendment.primary_endpoint: Source-normalized4-1BB-positive CD8 response at highest tested dose100 in original XLSX. Not affinity; normalization can exceed1.
functional_endpoint_amendment.primary_hit: response>=0.3, an operational source-fitting low-response heuristic; not a validated biological/clinical threshold; never above-parent improvement.
functional_endpoint_amendment.secondary_top_decile: Repeat all three modes against pool90th-percentile threshold as offline relative retrieval only, keeping identical selected sequences. Does not imply improved potency.
functional_endpoint_amendment.secondary_three_dose_AUC: Full three-dose log-concentration normalized trapezoid area, only complete source curves. Missing lower doses never imputed. Label-only cohort frozen before predictions; all three modes repeated, descriptive sensitivity only.
functional_endpoint_amendment.mode1_scope: Antigen mutation-site prioritization:9 positions with19 nonparent substitutions each, two selected sites=38 assays. Recognition-retaining variant yield, not proven affinity enhancement.
functional_endpoint_amendment.replication: 7 receptor contexts and3 antigen groups; receptor1/2 are related and share very similar alpha chains.
functional_endpoint_amendment.static_primary: HERMES py000 fixed and ProteinMPNN v48_020 full_pep_masked, AF3_no_template published scores, both oriented higher pnlogp better. Parent mean across9 WT technical rows.
functional_endpoint_amendment.static_sensitivity: ProteinMPNN v48_002 full_pep_masked AF3_no_template is a predeclared additional source-only comparator setting; repeat all modes2/3, report both settings without selecting a winning setting.
